text:
NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author reworked the PR description and squashed the work into one commit, but didn't change the code. The new comment just says "Ready for review!".

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | The description now has "Fixes #19589", a testing section and the self-review checklist. |
| ❌  | Nothing explains how this relates to open PR #38098 on the same issue. The issue is also assigned to pranjal499, who claimed it after this PR was opened. |
| ❌  | Testing is vague ("manually tested") with no concrete steps or results. The description also shows stray backslashes around `command` and `text`. |
| ⚠️  | Only the code and its test changed. The webhook payload docs weren't updated, and the `python-zulip-api` compatibility question from earlier attempts isn't addressed. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to explain how this relates to #38098 and the assigned issue. Consider closing if they can't, as was done for #38902.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the description! Before this can be reviewed, please explain how it relates to the open PR #38098 and the issue's current assignee, following our [guide on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html). Please also describe concretely how you manually tested it, and update the outgoing webhook payload docs to match the code.
```
